description: Your current grade in each active Canvas course from the Canvas gradebook, with the assignments behind each grade: your score, the points possible and the submission status. Pass course_id as the Canvas course ID or as the course name to limit the grades and the breakdown to one course. Example: "What is my grade in each Canvas course and which assignments make it up?"

course_id.description: Optional, limit the grades and the breakdown to one course.

name: get_my_grades
title: My grades
